market_overview.notes: Post-crash fragile tape. 7/21 was historic V-reversal (科创50 +10.73% intraday, 半导体设备 +14%) driven by 国家队 ETF buying and policy signaling. Today (7/22) indices hold green (+0.5% 上证, +0.6% 深证) but breadth is decisively negative: 3,455 declining vs 1,923 advancing (0.56:1). IV Rank 100% across all ETFs — extreme panic pricing. Resources/metals lead (贵金属 +8.1%, 工业金属 +5.6%) on dollar-credit concerns; consumer discretionary lags. No new positions: breadth below 1:1 minimum gate. 100% cash (¥956K), waiting for breadth >1.5:1 to deploy.株冶集团 is the #1 watch candidate when gate re-opens.
